details:
An advisory for this issue has been issued at <https://www.drupal.org/sa-contrib-2026-110> and an additional issue was identified and fixed via <https://www.drupal.org/sa-contrib-2026-111>

This module is now resupported. See that advisory for more details.

*Original content*  
The security team is marking this project unsupported. There is a known security issue with the project that has not been fixed by the maintainer. If you would like to maintain this project, please read: [https://www.drupal.org/node/251466#s-becoming-owner-maintainer-or-co-mai...](https://www.drupal.org/node/251466#s-becoming-owner-maintainer-or-co-maintainer-of-a-project-that-is-unsupported-for-security-reasons)
